Q5777.reason: Acute urinary retention is most often due to bladder outflow obstruction (commonly prostatic enlargement); haematuria, alcohol, and stones are less typical primary causes.

Q5779.reason: Standard UK infusion guidance (e.g. Royal Marsden) is to flush an unused peripheral cannula with 0.9% sodium chloride at least every 12 hours, and before and after each use.

Q5782.reason: Naming one clergy member to a secular licensing body does not per se advance or inhibit religion under the Establishment Clause; clergy are not barred from public office, and this is not a delegation of power to a church.
